description: Source file implementing the egl::Image class and related classes for EGL image handling within the ANGLE project, including image creation, management, and sibling relationships.

classes.name: ImageSibling
classes.description: Represents a sibling of an EGL image, managing relationships with target images and sources.

classes.name: ExternalImageSibling
classes.description: Represents an external EGL image sibling with implementation-specific behavior.

classes.name: ImageState
classes.description: Holds the state information for an EGL image, including target, format, size, and source.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Main class implementing EGL image objects, managing creation, initialization, and sibling relationships.

methods.name: GetImageIndex
methods.description: Determines the image index based on EGL target and attributes.

methods.name: DisplayFromContext
methods.description: Retrieves the display associated with a given GL context.

methods.name: ImageSibling::setTargetImage
methods.description: Sets the target image for this sibling and adds it as a target.

methods.name: ImageSibling::orphanImages
methods.description: Orphans the sibling images, removing relationships.

methods.name: Image::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the EGL image, setting format, size, and samples.

methods.name: Image::orphanSibling
methods.description: Orphans a sibling image, updating relationships accordingly.

methods.name: Image::getFormat
methods.description: Returns the format of the image.

methods.name: Image::isRenderable
methods.description: Checks if the image is renderable in the current context.

methods.name: Image::isTexturable
methods.description: Checks if the image can be used as a texture.
